versions.content: Usage of SwcServiceDependency s for vendor-specific ser- vices SwcServiceDependency s can also be used for vendor-specific services. In this case the SwcServiceDependency shall not contain any of the standardized ServiceNeeds . For this purpose the VendorSpecificServiceNeeds is avail- able.
